scope: Primary source and installed SDK accounting research only

sources.finding: macOS AVAILABLE_NON_COMPRESSED_MEMORY includes active, inactive, free and speculative counters; memorystatus level is not an allocatable free-byte budget.
Available accounting includes reclaimable memory; reclaiming anonymous pages may require compression or swapping. This does not prove no-pressure admission.
Per-process memory-limit remainder, not physical host headroom; installed SDK declares this API unavailable on macOS.

requiredBeforeAdmission: Specify conservative available-byte measurement without active/anonymous or speculative double counting
Measure normal pressure and stable swap under current load
Verify available >=1.5 GB and sealed aggregate ceiling +512 MiB margin
Physical-RAM fit and exclusive shared heavy-work lease
Real aggregate descendant capacity and pressure-loss teardown evidence
conclusion: Existing percentages are read-only host observations. No stack or supported inference has been admitted; resource owner implementation remains absent.
